# KeyboardDeviceConnected

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Keyboard](BlitzBasic-Keyboard)

</div>


```blitzbasic
KeyboardDeviceConnected:Int32 device:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device` | In | Int32 | required | The keyboard to ask, counted from 0 in the order they were seen. |

**Returns:** 1 if the keyboard is connected, otherwise 0 (also for a number that no keyboard has).

## Description

Tells if a keyboard is still plugged in. A keyboard that was removed keeps its number, so a number never means a different keyboard later on; one that is plugged in again gets its old number back.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Repeat
	Cls
	For i = 0 To KeyboardDeviceCount() - 1
		Text 10, 10 + i * 16, KeyboardDeviceName(i) + ": " + KeyboardDeviceConnected(i)
	Next
	Flip
Until KeyHit(1)
```
